newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian hotel raises capital through share issue.
newsitem.headline: Croatian hotel raises capital through share issue.

text.p: Croatian Hotel Bellevue from Dubrovnik on the Adriatic coast plans to raise five million kuna fresh capital through a new issue of shares.
In a paid advertisement in daily Slobodna Dalmacija, the company said it would issue 12,500 B-series ordinary shares at 400 kuna each.
The money is intended for reconstruction of the hotel facilities, badly damaged in the 1991 shelling of Dubrovnik.
The issue is open to Croatian and foreign private and corporate investors are 10 days from now at the hotel.
It has an equity of just under two million German marks.
The current shareholder structure includes one of the hotel's creditors with a 16-percent holding and small shareholders, controlling 41 percent.
Over 42 percent of Hotel Bellevue is reserved for restitution to pre-World War Two owners.
